name: Incus / LXD
description: Shows an Incus (or LXD) server or cluster: the servers as hosts and every container and virtual machine as a guest, with state, MAC and IP addresses (when the instance sits on your LAN rather than behind NAT), image, CPU and memory limits, and autostart. Read-only: it only sends GET requests with a client certificate that you add to the trust store as restricted.
author: Netlens
supports: Incus virtual machines and clusters, LXD (not tested)

releases.changelog: Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
